Written and skill test for the post of Librarian
Tuesday, 14 March 2023
3715 Hits
Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram Wardha invites the following candidates to appear for the written test at
10 AM
on
5/4/2023
at Exam Hall (above Operation Theatre), to be followed by Computer Skill Test for the post of Librarian.  The shortlisted candidates will be expected to appear for interview at a later date.
Please note that at the time of interview you have to bring all original certificates of qualifications, relevant work experience certificate, proof of date of birth, address proof including IT literacy qualifications with one set of photo copies (self-attested). Also bring recognition certificate from the recognized Institute / University etc. of requisite qualification.  No objection certificate from the present employer.
Also note that No TA & DA will be granted for the purpose.
List of shortlisted candidates for the post of Librarian
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
